item.title: Top 10 Methods to Truncate Time on a Datetime Object in Python
item.description:
In the realm of Python programming, one common requirement is the need to truncate time from a datetime object while preserving the date information. This can be crucial in applications like reporting or data analysis, where the focus is solely on records by date. This post outlines top 10 methods to achieve this, showcasing various techniques with practical examples.
